Where it runs
Builds, tests, CI, containers and the emulator run here.
A session can start on any of these, and its containers may live on any of them. One marked Hosting only takes containers alone, built on the project's node and sent there; its sessions may make, rebuild and remove them there under Claude may: Run its container. A hosting node not ticked is yours to copy to and rebuild on from the Docker tab.
